title: Logs name a person by a hex id while Synthesis gives the same person a voice label
what_happens: Each log row ends with a bare id like '8d565981', and the opened row shows the full UUID. Synthesis groups answers under a voice label (voiceLabels). Nothing links the two.
who_hurts: An admin chasing why one person's answer did or didn't reach the summary can't match a log row to the voice on Synthesis.
suggested_fix: Use the same voiceLabels(...) label in the log row and the participant filter chip, keeping the id in the opened details.
